title: NASA-UAP-D017, Preliminary Gemini 4 Crew Debriefing, Part II, 1965
doc_notes: This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 4 flight crew debriefing held on June 9, 1965, focusing on systems operation and visual sightings. / This document is a transcript of the Gemini 4 crew debriefing regarding visual sightings and operational experiments, containing some redactions and technical discussion.

incidents.summary: Astronauts McDivitt and White report visual sightings during the Gemini 4 mission.
Astronauts McDivitt and White observed debris and pieces of the adapter section during spacecraft separation.
incidents.quote: Just plain debris was all it was. Just pieces of white junk came by.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed a phenomenon described as parallel running lines of lights radiating from the earth up toward the spacecraft.
incidents.quote: They were just parallel running lines of lights radiating from the earth up toward us

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed fireflies or particles reflecting sunlight outside the spacecraft.
incidents.explanation: Reflections from fuel particles or spacecraft debris.
incidents.quote: millions and millions and millions of these fireflies or particles outside
